name: site-clone
description: Rebuild how a web page moves from its URL. study reads the page and sweeps scroll, rest, hover, and click across it. compare sweeps a rebuild the same way and lists what still differs. The skill form tells an agent how to loop the two until the differences run out.

verbs.name: study
verbs.description: Read a page, walk its whole scroll range, choose stops and targets from what the walk found, then sweep them twice so the second pass sets the noise floor. Writes everything to a workspace in the data home. Free, and takes minutes on a long page.

name.description: The workspace name, such as acme-home.

loadMs.description: How long a page gets to assemble itself after load.

idleMs.description: How long each rest at a stop records. Use at least two cycles of the slowest loop.

verbs.name: compare
verbs.description: Sweep a rebuild with the study's plan and list what differs from the original, largest first, with side-by-side frames per run. Each call adds a numbered round to the workspace. Free.

clone.description: URL of the rebuild, such as http://localhost:4400/.
